title: In 2024, MacKenzie Scott gave $2m each to 279 nonprofits in $640M giveaway after 6,000 applications
summary_full: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic initiative in 2024 selected 361 nonprofit organizations to receive $640 million. Through an open application process, more than 6,000 groups submitted requests for funding. The selected organizations focused on issues related to economic disparities, education, healthcare, and discrimination. Scott's approach shifted from private research to an open call, increasing both funding and recipients. This effort follows her significant charitable donations made after her divorce from Jeff Bezos.
